first.rationale: The immediate competitive threat is concentrated in price-sensitive SMB, where targeted promotional pricing previously produced acquisition and qualified-revenue lift across billing plans and reduced time-to-first-value. That direct competitive response may also partly address early adoption deterioration. Verify the pricing result and compare it with the onboarding evidence before launch; use a narrowly targeted, time-bounded offer with cohort-quality, retention, discount-dependence, activation, and payback guardrails to protect sustainable long-term revenue.
